context.alert_text: Failed executions of the order saga state machine above 5 in 5 minutes

root_cause.hypothesis: A state machine definition update (UpdateStateMachine -> PublishStateMachineVersion -> UpdateStateMachineAlias) deployed at 07:36:10-07:36:14Z introduced a breaking change to warden-dev-order-saga, causing nearly all new executions to fail (41 failed vs 3 succeeded out of 44 started) shortly after rollout.
evidence: C5: UpdateStateMachine change immediately precedes the failure spike
C4/C3: version publish and alias update complete the deploy sequence
M1-M3: failure ratio (41/44) vs success (3/44) indicates near-total breakage, not a transient blip
ruled_out: Throttling (M5=0) and timeouts (M4=0) are not contributing factors
Alarm missing-data is not the cause since datapoints=1/1 and state=ALARM, a real signal not a gap

proposal.reasoning: The failure spike began immediately after the UpdateStateMachine/PublishStateMachineVersion/UpdateStateMachineAlias sequence, with 41 of 44 executions failing post-deploy. Rolling back the state machine alias/version to the prior revision should restore the pre-deploy success rate.
proposal.expected_effect: New executions of warden-dev-order-saga route to the previous working state machine version/alias, restoring ExecutionsSucceeded rate and clearing the ExecutionsFailed alarm.

reasons: Rollback proposed but no recent deploy appears in the gathered context.
